notes: Encoded ONLY from EnergyRite's own page. No era floors, styles, or tables imported from any related page (no Cadet eras, no Style 9, no Crest/copper content), even though the pages look alike; the page states no eras in text, so all shipped styles use the default yearFloor 1960. The page states these serials are utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems, but no per-brand reuse is claimed here and no usesStylesOf is set. SHIPPED styles are those whose year (and week, where shipped) is stated in retrievable page text; month letters are chart-only, so styles 3-6 ship YEAR-ONLY per precedent. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both chart-only), page Style 7 (5Y013: year = 2nd letter, chart-only). COORDINATOR ADJUSTMENT (Wave 5 verification): page Style 8 IS SHIPPED (see style-8) — the order is determined on this page itself, not imported: the page's sentence order is 'year and month', and the page's own example forces it, since month-first would give month 97 (invalid) while year-first gives 1997-08 (valid).. See report for image-pass items.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges.

Year = 3rd & 4th characters in the page's raw form (dash is 2nd character), i.e. normalized positions [1,3] -> '93'. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only. List-vs-detail note: the page list shows J-93001 (6 characters normalized) and the detail shows J-930001 (7 characters normalized); the detail form is encoded here, and the list form falls under this file's style-6 shape (letter + 5 digits) where it decodes identically (same year positions, year-only), so no serial is lost or mis-decoded.
Year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits (normalized [1,3] -> '07'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.

styles.era: 8- or 9-character serials, letter + digits + letter, year only
styles.notes: List-vs-detail discrepancy per the Waves 3-4 lesson: the page list shows J93-1030F (8 characters normalized) and the detail shows J93 12030F (9 characters normalized). BOTH decode to year '93' under the stated positions (2nd & 3rd numerical digits -> [1,3]), and the combined pattern is disjoint from every other style in this file, so both forms are encoded and no winner is picked. Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.
Year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits (normalized [1,3] -> '78'). Month = 1st letter, chart-only, so year-only.

styles.era: 10-digit serials, last four digits are year + month
styles.notes: COORDINATOR ADJUSTMENT (Wave 5 verification): page states 'The last four digits of the serial number represent the year and month of manufacture.' Order is determined on this page itself: (1) sentence order is year-then-month; (2) the page's own example 1234569708 forces it — month-first would give month 97 (invalid), year-first gives year 1997, month 08 (valid). Same treatment as the identical Crest/Copper-Fin style-8 sections, but justified from this page's own text and example alone, not by import.
